description: Declares a type variable inside the `extends` clause of a conditional type. The compiler fills it by matching the checked type against the pattern.
The `extends` clause acts as a pattern with holes; the true branch can use every inferred hole.
TypeScript 4.7+: the inferred type must satisfy `C`. In template literals it also parses strings into number, bigint or boolean literals.
Inferring a parameter list yields a tuple like `[id: number, label?: string]` that keeps names, optional and rest elements.
